description: Create a score you write as a .cesure and open it as a draft, e.g. {"version":2,"score":{"title":"Song","tempo":96,"tracks":[{"name":"Guitar","instrument":"GUITAR","measures":[{"staves":[{"voices":["(0.6 2.5 2.4).2 r.2"]}]}]},{"name":"Bass","instrument":"BASS","tuning":[{"note":"G","octave":2},{"note":"D","octave":2},{"note":"A","octave":1},{"note":"E","octave":1}],"measures":[{"staves":[{"voices":["0.4.2 r.2"]}]}]}]}} (a track without tuning is a guitar in standard tuning; tuning lists the open strings from string 1). Every measure must read and fill its time signature, or nothing is created and the refusal names each fault with its place. Measure notation (.cesure): each voice is one string of beats separated by spaces. beat = content.duration[{d | tu 3}]; content = fret.string[{note props}] | pitch | (note note …) | r. Durations, on EVERY beat: 1 whole, 2 half, 4 quarter, 8, 16, 32, 64. Strings from 1 (the highest); x as fret mutes. A pitch (C4 = middle C, F#3, Bb2) lets Cesure choose string and fret; a staff is all by pitch or all fret.string. Beat props: d dotted, tu 3 triplet on each beat of the group. Note props: t tie, h hammer/pull-off and sl slide to the next note on that string, v vibrato, b (0 4) a whole-tone bend. EACH VOICE FILLS ITS TIME SIGNATURE EXACTLY: 4/4 = 4 quarters = 8 eighths, 3/4 = 3 quarters, 6/8 = 6 eighths; rests complete a short one. A measure without numerator/denominator is 4/4, whatever came before. A second voice (a bass under a melody) is a second string in voices. Examples (4/4): "5.3.4 7.3.4 r.2" (fret 5 then 7 on string 3 (strings from 1, the highest), quarters; a half rest); "(0.1 1.2 0.3).2 x.6.4 r.4" (a chord, a half; a muted note); "E4.8 F#4.8 G4.4 Bb3.2" (notes by pitch (C4 = middle C): Cesure chooses string and fret); "5.3.4{d} 5.3.8 2.1.8{tu 3} 3.1.8{tu 3} 5.1.8{tu 3} 7.2{h}.8 8.2.8" (dotted quarter; a triplet of eighths (each beat carries it); a hammer-on to the next note); "5.3.2 5.3{t}.4 7.2{sl}.8 9.2{v}.8" (a tie to the note before, a slide, a vibrato). A measure: {"id":"p2","numerator":3,"denominator":4,"staves":[{"voices":["0.1.8 2.1.8 3.1.4 5.1.4","0.6.2{d}"]}]}. The full format: https://cesure.app/format

score.description: The score, a .cesure written in the notation described above.
